title: </sub>  Reject credentials instead of trusting manifest declarations
text:
</sub>  Reject credentials instead of trusting manifest declarations

When an authentic credential-shaped value is accidentally added to a seed and also listed as its `forbiddenValue`, this design can treat that declaration as proof that the value is non-functional and allow the credential scan to pass. However, `forbiddenValue` currently only supplies strings to `redactForbiddenValues` (`src/cli/recall-benchmark.ts:327-343`) and says nothing about whether they authenticate. This makes the AC14 guard capable of green-lighting a real secret; limit exemptions to fixed, mechanically recognizable synthetic placeholders rather than arbitrary manifest values.
